why_superseded: This file originally compared the Nikki master against M_Poitou_Landscape_Painterly's layer names and concluded the Nikki paint lane was dead. That comparison used the wrong reference: L_Poitou_v2 does not use the painterly layer family at all. Its real target layers are the Houdini LandscapeLayerInfoObjects Base/Grass/Ground/Mud/Path/Rock/Water.

painterly_coverage_of_real_layers.note: Different layer family; zero overlap with the map's LandscapeLayerInfoObjects.

verdict: The Nikki paint lane reads 4 of 7 real baked layers. It is partial, not dead. The painterly master is a different layer family and is not assigned to any landscape.
evidence_level: graph-read only; no mutation, no PIE
